requirements.text: Master's degree or Engineering degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
2+ years of experience as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst.
Strong programming skills, particularly Python and SQL.
Proficiency in at least one major GenAI application framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Knowledge of both proprietary and open-source model ecosystems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral AI, Hugging Face, etc.).
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply.
To support its growth, Sia is recruiting a Data Scientist Consultant with a strong interest in Marketing, Customer, and Product topics and challenges.
Good understanding of machine learning techniques.
Good understanding of statistical techniques and concepts.
Experience developing conversational AI systems / chatbots.
Understanding of or experience with protocols and standards for connecting LLMs to external tools and databases, such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Experience deploying models at scale in production environments.

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.
